purpose: Numerically test whether frozen stress-energy-matched F0/F+/F- neutrino momentum distributions produce distinguishable collisionless momentum transfer in the same externally specified halo potential.
interpretation_boundary: Local frozen-z dynamics smoke test only; not a cosmological N-body result, not a galaxy/HOD response, not a survey observable, not a detection forecast.

frozen_inputs.kinetic_states: Original E8 4000-q CLASS-normalized F0/F+/F- construction, source-pinned by existing E8 code.
frozen_inputs.halo: Original E28 lower-mass DM14/NFW anchor at z_obs=0.95, using its M200c, c200c and comoving r_s without retuning.
frozen_inputs.duration: Proper-time interval z=1.0 to z=0.95 derived from the frozen FD E27 CLASS H(z) background.

particle_design.momentum_sampling: Equal-weight p(q) proportional to q^2 F_state(q), identical stratified quantiles across states.
particle_design.antithetic_pairing: Each sampled position/direction is paired with its spatial and directional negative; q magnitude is duplicated within the pair.
particle_design.halo_frame_velocity: Relativistic thermal velocity from q at z=0.95 plus bulk neutrino wind -V_halo along x.

dynamics.potential: Static spherical truncated NFW halo in physical coordinates; enclosed mass from the frozen E28 M200c,c200c,r_s anchor.

metrics.primary: D_state = mean(vx_final-vx_initial) for +200 km/s halo wind.
controls: M_halo=0 gives exactly zero momentum-transfer proxy.
Wind reversal flips D_state and C under the antithetic phase-space construction.

preregistered_resolution_gate.sign_consistency_required: C must have the same nonzero sign for coarse/fine time steps and half/full nested samples.
preregistered_resolution_gate.note: Passing this gate means only numerically resolved local hidden-state dynamics. It is not a detectability threshold.
